freeze_basis: Published teaching examples and B1 DESIGN V2; no engine implementation inspected for this comparison before this fixture commit.

policies.prices: Only explicitly hypothetical/constructed/made-up published examples are eligible. Missing OHLC components are omitted, not estimated or filled.
policies.closures: A closed flag may be supplied only when the article expressly describes a completed-bar observation; unspecified closure remains absent.
policies.scope: Published teacher judgments, V2 predictions, actual B1 output, and descriptive displacement measurements are separate; no source is attributed to a person other than its own publisher/author.
policies.independence: Mirrored cases, counterfactuals, boundary variants, and windows from the same sequence are related observations, not independent evidence.
policies.sources_unverified: An authorship byline is not proof of human-only composition. No article selected here declares chatbot generation; Swoopr, which declares AI assistance, is excluded conservatively.
policies.unsupported_interface: If a detector cannot consume the fields actually printed by the source, record NOT_RUN_MISSING_FIELDS; never repair the example by inventing values.
